editor.unsavedReadOnly: You can no longer edit this page.

editor.unsavedMovedAway: The block you typed in is no longer on this page (deleted or moved). If it was moved elsewhere, adding it back here makes a second copy.

editor.tabLimitWaiting_other: {{count}} of them are hidden pages still waiting for the server to confirm what you typed; the first place frees up within {{seconds}} s at the latest.
editor.offline: Offline: changes are kept and sent when the connection is back
editor.stalled: Too many unsent changes: waiting for the server
editor.deletedBy: {{name}} deleted the block you were in.
